market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from rate-hike repricing and energy inflation. Expect volatility in equities as Fed signals firm up. Oil likely stays $90-100. Yen strength pressures USD. 1-3 month outlook is choppy with downside risk if Fed pivots hawkish.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle and US-China engagement support 6-12 month equity upside, but energy inflation and potential Fed tightening cap gains. Structural shifts in FX (yen), sovereign gold relocation, and crypto institutionalization reshape the landscape. Balanced portfolio with energy, AI, and gold hedges is optimal.
